review_method.source_comparison: Compared the source with nine evenly spaced decoded frames and the 3x3 contact sheet.
review_method.technical_verification: Rechecked the recorded duration, dimensions, audio flag, SHA-256, and motion-metrics receipt.

observations.requested_motion: Only the central purple aura should contract and fade monotonically from its first-frame maximum while the infographic remains static.
observations.camera: The camera and square framing remain fixed.
invariant_failures: The aura becomes a large dark circular ring and expands to roughly 0.894 of the measured ROI before shrinking.
The measured purple trajectory has six material monotonic-decrease violations.
The provider returned 1440x1440 with audio despite the requested 1080p no-audio contract.

verdict.summary: Explicit monotonic wording did not constrain the trajectory: the aura expands into a large dark ring before fading.
